newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Regional concerns to weigh Singapore stock market.
newsitem.headline: Regional concerns to weigh Singapore stock market.

text.p: Regional concerns would continue to overshadow domestic corporate news on Wednesday and cap any potential upside in Singapore shares, dealers said.
"It's not so much company fundamentals investors are worried about now, but more regional currencies," a local dealer said.
"There are some stocks which look cheap at these levels, but it's hard to convince people to buy now because there is just a lack of confidence in the market," he added.
Dealers expected the key Straits Times Industrials (STI) index to move towards 1,900 where the index-linked stocks would be fundamentally supported.
The STI index ended 17.51 points down on Tuesday at 1,937.09 while Wall Street closed up 52.73 points at 7,975.71.
